# Seventh review of SEEN-108, attempt 10, from the seen-reviewer subagent

Spawned fresh on opus with the task text of triage record 109, and told that
note 110's stopping rule existed and did not ask it to soften anything. Verdict
`return`, five findings, two medium, so the rule takes another round rather than
delivering. It compared every accepted tdd advance's failure reason against its
cited check, confirmed the three the journal already corrects, and judged
`slice_files` a plan-accuracy gap for the sixth time, having read all nine
unplanned files.

- **F1, medium, harness/agents.py:106.** `routed` read
  `handoff.current_slice`, which infers the count from greens, so its answer
  moved the moment a slice was proved; only route, a boundary and the solution
  advance rewrite the copies, so doctor reported drift on a tree nobody had
  edited, and CI runs doctor on every push and every pull request. Worse at the
  end of a plan, where no handoff follows the last slice and the drift persists
  through the advance, the review and the receipt. Reproduced in a fixture and
  found to have already happened on this branch at commit adbdb4c.
- **F2, medium, the ticket file.** The outcome's counts were wrong in three
  places, inside the paragraph that says they are read from the journal rather
  than recalled: "thirty-four findings" where the list beside it sums to
  thirty-one, "four of the returns came from a review" where the journal holds
  nine review-stage returns, and "all four reviews" where there were six. The
  same defect the fourth review returned the ticket for as F4, in the section
  written to fix it.
- **F3, low, harness/tests/test_agents.py.** `GuardIsLastTest` matched its own
  string literal, so it would have failed on the module it lives in, which has
  no guard and does contain that literal.
- **F4, low, harness/report.py:186.** The Points priced cell was guarded by no
  test: every fixture had `priced_points` equal to `slices`, so printing the
  slice count instead kept the suite green and reinstated the non-reconciling
  row the sixth review returned the ticket for.
- **F5, low, harness/tests/test_routing.py.** The 1,036 lines this ticket adds
  had no `unittest.main` guard, so a direct run collected nothing and said so by
  printing nothing, and `GuardIsLastTest` skipped exactly the modules with none,
  which was sixteen of the twenty-five.
